stem:
In her science class, Meera learns that mercury conducts heat and electricity well, so mercury is a ……1…… , even though it is a ……2…… at room temperature.

Which words correctly complete gaps 1 and 2?

teacher.key_rationale: Mercury conducts heat and electricity, which are metallic properties, so gap 1 is 'metal'; the named exception is that mercury is a liquid at room temperature, so gap 2 is 'liquid'. Option C (metal; liquid) is correct. Option A traps a student who over-applies the rule that metals are hard, shiny solids and classifies anything liquid as a non-metal; B drops the exception; D misclassifies on both counts.
